title: Payment Conduct Bands for Northgate Card Credit Line Increases
content:
On a requested credit line increase for a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account, the percentage of the current credit limit at which the line increase is taken follows the account's payment conduct over the last 12 months:

- where no late fee and no returned payment were recorded in that time (0 late fees, 0 returned payments), it is 20 percent;
- where exactly one returned payment and no more than two late fees were recorded in that time, it is 5 percent;
- where more than two late fees or more than one returned payment were recorded in that time, it is nothing;
- in every other case, one or two late fees and no returned payment, it is 10 percent.

**Counting.** A count over the last 12 months takes the entries dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the review date. Late fees are the late payment fees charged on the account; returned payments are the payments returned unpaid.

| Late fees in the last 12 months | Returned payments in the last 12 months | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 20 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 0 | 10 percent |
| 0, 1 or 2 | 1 | 5 percent |
| 3 or more | any | nothing |
| any | 2 or more | nothing |

**Window boundary (hypothetical review on the 15th of a month).** A late fee dated the 15th of the same month a year earlier is outside the window; one dated the 16th of that month is inside it.
